input.overview: World Cup is a goal-based bonus game. The left orbit is the best repeatable route because it immediately lights Goal, feeds the top lanes for S-T-A-R, and raises its own carried-over value as goals accumulate. Spell S-T-A-R for 2x, 3x, and 5x Bonus; goals carry across balls, but the multiplier does not.
input.simpleOverview: Keep shooting the left orbit. It lights Goal and feeds the top lanes, where you can score goals and S-T-A-R letters. Spell STAR for 2x, 3x, then 5x Bonus.
input.summary: Go up the left side all day, let the top and side kickouts find goals and STAR letters, and protect the large goal bonus instead of forcing the center spinner.

quickInfo.name: Light Goal
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the left orbit, Corner Kick, or upper-right Super Ball lane.

quickInfo.name: Score Goal
quickInfo.summary: Enter either lit side saucer or the lit top-center Goal lane.

quickInfo.name: Best Repeat
quickInfo.summary: Use the left orbit to light Goal and return up top.

steps.text: Shoot the left orbit to light Goal and feed the top arch.
Use the top lanes and side kickouts to collect S-T-A-R letters and let the ball find a lit goal saucer.
Repeat S-T-A-R completions to raise Bonus X from 2x to 3x to 5x.
Keep building the carried-over goal count and preserve the multiplied end-of-ball bonus.

alternatives.title: Corner Kick goal
alternatives.when: Use this when the right-side lane is naturally available rather than forcing it from a trapless flipper return.

steps.text: Enter the Corner Kick lane to light Goal.
Let the lane feed the right goal saucer.
Use the saucer kickout or flipper-elbow cup to set up the next left-orbit shot.
Keep Goal lit and score goals early because goal count carries across balls.
Complete S-T-A-R three times during the current ball for 5x.
Drain without tilting to collect the maximum 180,000 goal bonus.

machineSetup: Test both goal saucers and kickouts, top-center Goal lane, left orbit, Corner Kick, S-T-A-R switches, flipper-elbow cups, goal lamps, and bonus lamps.
Confirm liberal or normal STAR thresholds, Special and Extra Ball conversion, three- or five-ball play, and the tilt penalty that can erase collected goals.

playfieldReferences.label: Left Super Ball lane
playfieldReferences.description: Primary up-top shot that lights Goal and increases in value.

playfieldReferences.label: Side goal saucers
playfieldReferences.description: Left and right saucers that score a goal when lit.

playfieldReferences.label: Top Goal rollover
playfieldReferences.description: Center top lane that scores Goal or Extra Ball when lit.

playfieldReferences.label: Flipper-elbow kickout cups
playfieldReferences.description: Lower cups that score STAR letters and return the ball toward play.

cautions.issue: The flipper layout has no normal inlanes, and tilting can erase the accumulated goals.
cautions.response: Use catches and the kickout cups instead of expecting a cradle, and protect the carried-over goal count with restrained nudging.
